summary: Implementation plan to integrate all 6 clinical and visual enhancements: 1) Live Lead-II phosphor ECG rhythm strip with crisis morphing, 2) Oxygenation-gradient blood flow velocity vectors, 3) SBAR shift handoff voice briefing with synchronized transcript banner, 4) Bedside mechanical ventilator waveforms (Paw, Flow, Volume), 5) Holographic 3D caliper measurement tool in Cinema mode, 6) ICU Ward SOFA/MEWS triage matrix, and 7) Highly responsive Web Audio cardiac sound engine with instant feedback.
